title: Technology Sector Update for 02/13/2018: MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG, AVGO, QCOM, NVMI, EIGI, HIMX, NTAP
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.4%
AAPL: -0.6%
IBM: -0.3%
CSCO: flat
GOOG: -0.3%
Technology shares were mostly lower in pre-market trading on Tuesday.
Expected movers:
- Broadcom ( AVGO ): will now seek election of six nominees to Qualcomm ( QCOM ) board, down from 11 previously
- Nova Measuring Instruments ( NVMI ): Q4 results beat views
- Endurance International ( EIGI ): Q4 results exceed expectations; sees 2018 revenue shy of views
- Himax Technologies ( HIMX ): Q4 adjusted profit meets Street mark, revenue misses
Other news:
- NetApp (NTAP): upgraded to Buy from Neutral at Bank of America
